item.content:encoded:
See all the upcoming library events below or visit the main events page at www.mysaline.com/events

Below are the in-person and virtual programs taking place at the Saline County Library for this week. There is something for all ages, and different categories of activities, like fitness, games, language, crafts, stories, clubs, and of course a New Year celebration this time! Read more below:
 

Chair Yoga- Group 1

Monday, August 10: 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM

 

Kick off your week with a Mindful Monday Chair Yoga session. Come as you are and enjoy a low-impact, low-stress, and accessible workout. No equipment needed. No prior experience needed.

 

Learn More

East End Elevenses

Monday, August 10: 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM

 

Try out a little bit of everything with East End Elevenses! Each week will be a different activity for adults and will include a book club, yoga, crafts and recipe swaps!

First Monday: Book Club
Second Monday: Yoga
Third Monday: Crafts
Fourth Monday: Recipe Swap

If there’s a fifth Monday during the month, look forward to a fun surprise!

 

Learn More

Chair Yoga- Group 2

Monday, August 10: 11:15 AM – 12:15 PM

 

Kick off your week with a Mindful Monday Chair Yoga session. Come as you are and enjoy a low-impact, low-stress, and accessible workout. No equipment needed. No prior experience needed.

 

Learn More

Who-Dun-It Book Club

Monday, August 10: 5:00 PM – 5:30 PM

 

Join East End’s whodunnit book club for a fun, interactive four-week journey! Each month, the club kicks off with an intro and chapter plan for this month’s book, and then we dive deeper each week with discussions, theories, and your best guesses at solving the crime. In the final week, we’ll reveal WHO-DUN-IT, celebrate winners with prizes, and unveil next month’s mystery.

 

Learn More

Morning Makers

Tuesday, August 11: 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM

 

Kick off your morning with creativity! Join us each week for a fun, guided craft—perfect for all skill levels. Every session features a new project, and all supplies are provided. Just show up, relax, and get crafty!

This program is for ages 18+.  Registration is required.

 

Learn More

Line Dancing

Tuesday, August 11: 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM

 

Put on your dancing shoes and join us for Line Dancing at the Benton Library! This fun, energetic class is open to adults ages 18 and up. All skill levels are welcome—whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned dancer, you’ll learn easy-to-follow steps and enjoy great music in a relaxed, supportive environment.

 

Learn More

Library Card Shufflers

Tuesday, August 11: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM

 

Come play cards with us. We play all kinds of card games like Canasta, Hand and Foot, Hearts, Spades, Rummy, and more. Bring some friends along or just come and make new ones. No prior gameplay experience needed – we are always happy to teach a new player.

 

Learn More

Strings & Things

Wednesday, August 12: 4:00 PM – 5:00 PM

 

All inclusive fiber art “get-together” for teens and adults where we crochet, knit, embroider, etc. and chat. All skill levels welcome, we can teach each other our crafts.

 

Learn More

Literary Tea Society – Book Club

Wednesday, August 12: 5:00 PM – 6:30 PM

 

The Literary Tea Society is a book club for adults that spans all genres and topics – much like the blends in our tea cabinet. We’re eager for new book recommendations to sample, and welcome new members to the Society. Every month we’ll meet for a lovely cup of tea, with tea blends themed to our current book selection! Join our Society on the 2nd Wednesday of each month from 5:00 PM to 6:30 PM for discussion, sips, and good literary fun!

 

This month: “West with Giraffes” by Lynda Rutledge.

 

 

Learn More

Tech Thursday

Thursday, August 13: 9:30 AM – 2:00 PM

 

Have questions about your tech? Drop in for a personal 30 minute appointment for help with printing, scanning, downloading eBooks, using your tablet, formatting documents, etc! Walk-ins are welcome; appointments are recommended. Email joelb@salinecountylibrary.orgfor questions or to set up an appointment.

 

Learn More

Makerspace Open Hours

Thursday, August 13: 2:00 PM – 5:30 PM

 

Drop by the Makerspace to utilize our amazing array of materials and equipment. Work on a project or learn something new! During Open Hours, Makerspace functions as an open workspace stocked with numerous tools, materials and equipment for independent creative time.  Bring a project you’re working on or come with your imagination and create to your heart’s content.  Take home what you make!

 

Learn More

Tai Chi

Friday, August 14: 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM

 

Connect your mind, body, and breath in this low-impact, meditative movement session. All levels welcome. No equipment needed.

 

Learn More

Pilates

Friday, August 14: 12:30 PM – 1:30 PM

 

Join us for a mat-based Pilates class with a Yoga twist. All levels are welcome. Bring your own yoga mat if desired, but all equipment will be available.

 

Learn More

CPR Basics Workshop

Saturday, August 15: 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM

 

Learn how to recognize heart attacks, cardiac arrest and the basics of CPR.  You could help save a life! This informative workshop will introduce participants to the fundamentals of cardiopulmonary resuscitation, including when and how to perform CPR in an emergency situation.

We are pleased to present this workshop in conjunction with Saline Memorial Hospital, whose healthcare professionals will guide participants through essential life-saving techniques and answer questions. This session is designed for beginners and anyone interested in learning practical emergency response skills.

All are welcome. No prior experience is required.

 

 

Learn More

Monday Hangouts

Monday, August 10: 4:00 PM – 5:00 PM

 

Want to make a new friend or play a game with your favorite library friends? Monday Hangouts are the solution you’ve been looking for! Our teen librarian, Ms. Chelsea, will be in the Teen Area with board games, video games, and some snacks every Monday!

Come to library for a fun Saturday afternoon for a short storytime with a different Youth Service librarian every week. We’ll sing songs and read stories starting at 10:30 in the storytime room. We can’t wait to see you there!
